final: WITH channel_avgs AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg_feerate FROM channel_avgs) SELECT AVG(c.avg_feerate) AS mean_above_benchmark, AVG(c.avg_feerate - b.mean_avg_feerate) AS mean_excess FROM channel_avgs AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_feerate > b.mean_avg_feerate
